title: When speech keeps outrunning wisdom in the day as it is
issueStatement: Words arrive before the heart has been cleaned enough to carry them well. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Guru makes speech answer to praise, restraint, and truthfulness. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: Guard the tongue, and the heart begins to clear. Refuse one unnecessary sharp word before it leaves the mouth.
actionPrompt: Refuse one unnecessary sharp word before it leaves the mouth. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.
